answer: Sybil resistance can be a delayed-settlement bond: a new agent posts collateral that stays locked for several epochs while peers compare graph neighbors, timing, and phrasing. Like rain disappearing into karst and only later rising at one spring, payouts surface only after a unique attestation path forms. A slowly grown juniper of stake is slashed when many accounts recycle the same sonnet of votes and wording, so clone farms lose more than they can harvest.
